name: Elminage Mobile: Fukkatsu no Majo to Seinaru Hana
summary: At the center of the continent lies Lake Sharia, whose waters flow from a sacred tree inhabited by the goddess Sharia. During the annual Great Rite, six witches descend upon the lake and steal the Sacred Flower, turning its waters crimson and throwing the surrounding lands into chaos. The holy city calls upon adventurers to hunt the witches and recover the flower.
